title_en: Interpretation (II) of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases

articles.content_en: Article 1: Where a contractor with legal business qualifications subcontracts or assigns contracted business to an organization or individual without legal business qualifications, and the workers employed by such organization or individual request confirmation that the contractor is the entity bearing the primary responsibility for employment, and shall bear the responsibility for paying labor remuneration, work-related injury insurance benefits after the determination of work-related injury, and other liabilities, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.

Article 2: Where an organization or individual without legal business qualifications operates externally by affiliating with a unit that has legal business qualifications, and the workers employed by such organization or individual request confirmation that the affiliated unit is the entity bearing the primary responsibility for employment, and shall bear the responsibility for paying labor remuneration, work-related injury insurance benefits after the determination of work-related injury, and other liabilities, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.

Article 3: Where a worker is employed alternately or simultaneously by multiple units that are related, and the worker requests confirmation of the labor relationship, the People's Court shall handle the matter according to the following circumstances:
(1) If a written labor contract has been concluded, and the worker requests confirmation of the labor relationship based on the labor contract, the People's Court shall support such request according to law;
(2) If no written labor contract has been concluded, the labor relationship shall be confirmed based on the employment management practices, taking into comprehensive consideration factors such as working hours, work content, payment of labor remuneration, payment of social insurance premiums, etc.
Where a worker requests the related units that fall under the circumstances specified in item (2) of the preceding paragraph to jointly bear the responsibility for paying labor remuneration, welfare benefits, and other liabilities, the People's Court shall support such request according to law, unless the related units have made an agreement according to law on the worker's labor remuneration, welfare benefits, etc., and the worker has consented thereto.

Article 5: A resident representative office of a foreign enterprise established according to law may serve as a party in a labor dispute case. Where a party applies to add the foreign enterprise to participate in the litigation, the People's Court shall support such application according to law.

Article 6: Where an employer fails to conclude a written labor contract with a worker according to law, the double wages payable to the worker shall be calculated on a monthly basis; if the period is less than one month, it shall be calculated based on the actual working days of that month.

Article 9: Where evidence proves the existence of the circumstances specified in Article 14, paragraph 3 of the Labor Contract Law that "the employer and the worker shall be deemed to have concluded an open-ended labor contract," and the worker requests the employer to conclude a written labor contract, the People's Court shall support such request according to law; where the worker requests the employer to pay double wages for the period during which the open-ended labor contract is deemed to have been concluded, on the ground that the employer has not supplemented the written labor contract in a timely manner, the People's Court shall not support such request.

Article 11: After the expiration of a labor contract, where the worker continues to work for the employer, and the employer does not express any objection for more than one month, and the worker requests the employer to renew the labor contract on the original terms, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.
Where the conditions for concluding an open-ended labor contract are met, and the worker requests the employer to conclude an open-ended labor contract on the original terms, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.
Where the employer dissolves the labor contract, and the worker requests the employer to bear the legal consequences of dissolving the labor contract according to law, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.

Article 12: In addition to paying normal labor remuneration to the worker, where the employer and the worker agree on a service period and provide special benefits, and the worker violates the agreement by prematurely dissolving the labor contract and does not meet the conditions for unilateral dissolution of the labor contract under Article 38 of the Labor Contract Law, and the employer requests the worker to bear liability for damages, the People's Court may, taking into comprehensive consideration factors such as the actual losses, the degree of fault of the parties, and the number of years already performed, determine the worker's liability for compensation.

Article 13: Where the worker has not learned of or had access to the employer's trade secrets and confidential information related to intellectual property, and the worker requests confirmation that the non-competition clause is not effective, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.
Where the scope, territory, term, and other contents of the non-competition clause are not commensurate with the trade secrets and confidential information related to intellectual property that the worker has learned of or had access to, and the worker requests confirmation that the portion of the non-competition clause exceeding a reasonable proportion is invalid, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.

Article 14: Where the employer agrees with senior officers, senior technical personnel, and other persons with confidentiality obligations on a non-competition clause during the term of employment, and the worker requests confirmation that the non-competition clause is invalid on the grounds that non-competition during employment may not be agreed upon or that economic compensation has not been paid, the People's Court shall not support such request.

Article 15: Where a worker violates a valid non-competition agreement, and the employer requests the worker to return the economic compensation already paid and pay liquidated damages in accordance with the agreement, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.

Article 18: Where the employer illegally dissolves or terminates a labor contract that can be further performed, and the worker requests the employer to pay wages for the period from the date of the illegal dissolution or termination decision to the day before the labor contract is resumed, the employer shall pay the worker wages for the aforementioned period at the wage rate applicable when the worker provides normal labor.
Where both the employer and the worker are at fault for the dissolution or termination of the labor contract, they shall each bear their respective responsibilities.

Article 19: Where the employer and the worker agree, or the worker promises to the employer, that social insurance premiums need not be paid, the People's Court shall determine that such agreement or promise is invalid. Where the employer fails to pay social insurance premiums according to law, and the worker requests to dissolve the labor contract and requests the employer to pay economic compensation in accordance with Article 38, paragraph 1, subparagraph (3) of the Labor Contract Law, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.
Where the circumstances in the preceding paragraph exist, and after the employer pays the social insurance premiums retroactively according to law, the employer requests the worker to return the social insurance premium compensation already paid, the People's Court shall support such request according to law.

Article 20: Where a party fails to raise a statute of limitations defense in arbitration due to its own reasons, and raises such defense during the first instance or second instance litigation, the People's Court shall not support such defense. Where a party, based on new evidence, can prove that the statute of limitations period for the other party's claim in arbitration has expired, the People's Court shall support such defense.
Where a party fails to raise the statute of limitations defense in accordance with the preceding paragraph, and applies for retrial or raises a retrial defense on the ground that the statute of limitations period has expired, the People's Court shall not support such request.

Article 21: This Interpretation shall come into force as of September 1, 2025. Paragraph 1 of Article 32 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases (I) (Fa Shi [2020] No. 26) shall be abolished simultaneously. Where any judicial interpretation previously issued by the Supreme People's Court is inconsistent with this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall prevail.
